unrecordedQuestions: For the "how long ago" timestamp — my recommendation: **compute it once when the strip renders** (e.g. "3m ago", "2h ago", "yesterday") and don't bother live-updating it while the page sits open. It's a convenience label; re-rendering on navigation is enough. Good, or do you want it ticking live? (offered choices: Compute on render, no live ticking (recommended); Live-update the timestamps periodically) (its recommendation: Compute on render, no live ticking (recommended))
